description:
Every year, around 1 million tons of discarded clothing arrive in Panipat, India. Here, workers sort, shred, bleach and dye old garments into new yarn, rugs and blankets. But the process exposes them to textile dust, dangerous machinery and harsh chemicals. We followed the route of the world's unwanted clothes to see who pays the price for their second life.
